supercharger_access.notes: BMW Canada (2026-04-08): CCS-port BMW BEVs get Supercharger access via RSU and the approved Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter; the i4 keeps its CCS1 port (native NACS only on all-new 2026+ models such as iX3, i3). US access began 2025-12-10 (BMWBlog lists i4).

wheels.notes: eDrive40 (2026 page): 18 x 7.5 in aluminum, P225/50R18. The page says the M Sport package adds larger wheels without a size, so no option is recorded. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
